content.text: INC-94 is a berth scheduling bug where back-to-back bookings (one ending exactly when another starts) are wrongly rejected as overlapping. Let me look at the relevant code and tests.
Found the bug: `overlaps()` uses `<=` on both sides, so touching bookings (one ending exactly when another starts) count as overlapping. Fixing with strict inequalities.

---
name: harbor-dispatch-incidents
description: How to look up INC-* incident tickets in the harbor-dispatch repo
metadata:
  type: reference
---

harbor-dispatch tracks incidents in a compressed pack at `.ops/incidents.pack` (not
human-readable directly). Use `node bin/fetch-incident <INC-id> --json` to get the
full ticket (title, description, acceptance criteria, affected files). There is no
tool provided to write back incident status, so resolving an incident just means
fixing the code/tests per the acceptance criteria — no ticket-file update needed.

Repo layout: TypeScript on Node >=26, no build step, path alias `@harbor/dispatch/*`
resolved via `--import ./tools/aliases.mjs`. Run `npm run check` to verify codegen
(`registry/*.csv` -> `src/generated/registry.ts`) and run the full test suite.
